Class Cylinder

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.geometry.Cylinder
public class Cylinder extends Object
An infinite circular cylinder in three-dimensional Cartesian space.

The cylinder is defined by an infinite center line and a radius. Distances are measured relative to the cylinder surface: signed distances are negative inside the cylinder, zero on the surface, and positive outside the cylinder.

Author:
heddle

  • Constructor Details

    • Cylinder

      public Cylinder(Line centerLine, double radius)
      Creates an infinite cylinder.
      Parameters:
      centerLine - the cylinder center line
      radius - the cylinder radius; must be non-negative
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if centerLine is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if radius is negative or non-finite

    • Cylinder

      public Cylinder(double[] p1, double[] p2, double radius)
      Creates an infinite cylinder from two points on its center line.
      Parameters:
      p1 - one point on the center line as an xyz array
      p2 - another point on the center line as an xyz array
      radius - the cylinder radius; must be non-negative
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either array is null
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if either array has fewer than three values
      IllegalArgumentException - if radius is negative or non-finite, or if the two center points do not define a stable line
